metric.name: ECAPA cosine to an independent three-utterance enrollment prototype

counterexamples.perceptual_summary: One exploratory developer listener judged both clones the same person, natural and usable.
counterexamples.scope: Selected post-hoc example, not a method-wide failure rate or population result.
limitations: One exploratory developer listener, one selected counterexample; not population evidence or a failure rate.
The original 104-item listening session identified only 2/4 hidden different-speaker controls; this limits identity reliability.
The protected input itself was rated severe noise, naturalness 1/5, quality unacceptable; this is not a successful input-preserving defense.
Official Python-example reproduction: VCTK adaptation, final epoch, mask_ratio=0.3; not full paper benchmark or deployment replication.
ECAPA shares the model family used in optimization. WeSpeaker accepts this protected clone (0.495).
Post-hoc illustrative selection, not a prospectively selected evaluation.

metric.name: ECAPA cosine to an independent three-utterance enrollment prototype

counterexamples.perceptual_summary: One exploratory developer listener judged the protected clone probably the same person, usable, correct in content, and without an audible anomaly.
counterexamples.scope: Selected post-hoc example, not a method-wide failure rate or population result.
limitations: One exploratory developer listener, one selected counterexample; not a population estimate or method-wide failure rate.
The protected input was rated probably the same speaker but communication unacceptable, with impairing noise; this is not input-preserving success.
The original reference is only 1.24 seconds.
Protected-clone original FLOAT WAV has peak 1.39898 and 13 of 114944 samples above absolute 1. Preserve the exact original and disclose any gain/transcoding for presentation.
Historical acceptance thresholds came from VCTK and were not recalibrated on LibriTTS. Use paired continuous scores, not rejection as calibrated evidence.
Official upstream G checkpoint lacked emb_g.weight; official loader kept seed=42 initialization. Activation checkpointing was used to retain official batch=27 on A100.
The paper-style direct SIM uses actual references and is a different metric: 0.68169→0.40843, both >0.25; do not substitute enrollment cosines into the paper threshold.
Later 100-item review found mixed SafeSpeech outcomes: G001 protected output was unacceptable, G004 probably different. Do not say every sample remained normal.
Post-hoc illustrative selection, not a prospectively selected evaluation.

limitations: 16x16 condition heatmaps are display reshapes, not spatial feature maps.
OpenVoice and FreeVC native spaces are distinct even though both have 256 values.
The perturbation x10 display is magnified for visibility.
The six dictionary columns are low/mid/high components of two earlier perturbations; these are not six independent non-overlapping frequency bands.
The sampled JSON and plots illustrate the representation; they do not establish perceptual success or transfer.

evidence_scope.listener_summary: One exploratory developer listener. Non-blind for the earlier OpenVoice pilots.
evidence_scope.paper_streaming_scope: The earlier streaming manuscript and the later per-recording native-condition optimization pilots are separate methods and evidence. The latter is not a real-time streaming-protection result.
pilot_limitations: Selected from four planned v41 construction units; two completed and two stopped at numerical checks. Do not present 2/2 as a general success rate.
The two examples cover two target speakers, not independent listeners or an unseen test set.
No claim of perceptual identity equivalence or inaudibility follows from subjective input identity/use ratings.
The change is output identity, not a destroyed, noisy or unintelligible output: all selected protected output quality ratings are 5 and content is correct.

The p264 donor internal diagnostic was excluded at the user request due contradictory answers. This does not remove its independently complete real-P chain. Do not use that diagnostic as a demonstrated donor-control positive.
v39 supports three finite contexts for an older p257/reference_0 WAV, not three repetitions of either selected v41 WAV.
The selected original-reference files are the rated 24kHz originals; the VC uses canonical 22.05kHz equivalents according to the frozen native frontend. Keep this origin linkage in notes.
Present-day audience playback against only original x is illustrative, not a replacement for the original three independent enrollment anchors.

Latest v51r1 Qwen hidden repeat retained protected-output identity shift but input had audible noise and affected_usable ratings. Strict normal-input joint success remains unconfirmed for Qwen; no other-model or general transfer success is supported by these OpenVoice samples.
